pages.title: Lights
pages.text: $(bold)Panel Light:$() light level 15 for 0.1 kW. Silent; no heat or oxygen.

pages.title: Emergency Light
pages.text: Off while the grid is healthy, charging its own battery for free. When normal lighting loses power, it glows dim red, level 6, for up to $(bold)10 minutes$().
Right-click to read the time left. Reconnect a healthy grid to recharge it; new or replaced lights start empty.$(br2)Mounts on a floor, wall or ceiling. It can't seal a hole.
No heat, no sound. It isn't the flickering light found in ruins.

pages.title: Panel Light
pages.text: Iron, glass and redstone. Makes two.

pages.title: Emergency Light
pages.text: Iron, red glass, redstone and copper.
